goal: Make the production business-risk classifier allowlist-only: a migration reports no business risk only when every top-level statement fullmatches one entry of a single ALLOWLIST constant (create function in sql/plpgsql without security definer, set or argument defaults; drop function if exists without cascade; one nullable built-in-type add column; plain create table; create index on a table created earlier in the migration; comment on). Every other statement, including WITH, EXPLAIN, DO, SELECT and unparsed SQL, reports all three risks. The two refused production migrations give no finding.
assumptions: Postgres refuses a non-CASCADE DROP FUNCTION while dependents exist, so it removes no rows.
A nullable ADD COLUMN of a built-in type with no default is a catalog-only change.
CREATE FUNCTION does not execute the routine body.
sql_top_level_statements removes comments and neutralises string and dollar-quoted bodies.
